digest.component_or_area: plan review verdict dispatch and degradation handling
propositions: Malformed repository criteria configuration raises CriteriaError during deterministic assemble-criteria step, but generic workflow recorder preserves only undifferentiated failed-step string, losing typed exception identity.

Generic gate dispatch routes every unrecovered workflow failure through degraded LLM handler, which unconditionally stamps llm_unavailable=True regardless of whether any LLM/provider call executed or the failure originated from local criteria assembly.

Criteria parsing failure must emit fail-closed INDETERMINATE verdict with distinct config_fault diagnostic (without llm_unavailable flag) that explicitly names installed build as suspect and directs operator to repository checkout build.
Deterministic findings and coverage must be preserved in config-fault verdict path; genuine LLMUnavailableError and healthy provider control paths must remain behaviorally unchanged.
Assemble-criteria step output contract must document stable structured failure_kind=criteria_config marker to enable downstream verdict routing.
